# Vendored Firebird OO API headers

`include/firebird/Interface.h` and `include/firebird/IdlFbInterfaces.h`,
unmodified, from the same Firebird 5.0.3 install as the headers in
`third_party/firebird/`. The extension uses them only for Firebird 4+
batched writes (`IBatch`), at compile time: their calls go through
interface vtables reached from `fb_get_master_interface()` and the
`fb_get_statement_interface()` / `fb_get_transaction_interface()`
bridges, which `src/firebird_client_loader.cpp` resolves at runtime like
the ISC entry points.

They sit apart from `third_party/firebird/`, which holds what comes with
`ibase.h`. `Interface.h` includes `ibase.h`, found there through the
include path. CMake adds this directory after that one, so a build with
`FB_SDK_ROOT` (the Windows CI builds use the Firebird 4.0.5 SDK) uses the
SDK's own OO headers instead. The OO interfaces are versioned, and the
batch code calls only what Firebird 4.0 has.
